Incident triage: LabHighLatency
Probable cause: ConfigurationError in demo/deployment/frontend (confidence high)
A recent configuration change updated the --backend-url argument to point to port 9899, but the backend service is likely not reachable or not configured to listen on that port, causing connection timeouts in the application logs.

Evidence:
- [A5 K8s API: deployments] A recent deployment update (revision 42) changed the --backend-url argument from port 9898 to 9899.
- [A4 K8s API: pods/log] Application logs show repeated backend call failures with 'context canceled' when attempting to connect to 'http://backend.demo.svc.cluster.local:9899/echo'.
- [A11 Prometheus] The 95th percentile latency is 2.3 seconds, significantly exceeding the 500ms threshold.

Suggested next steps (not executed; a person decides):
- Revert the frontend deployment to the previous revision (32) or correct the backend URL configuration to point to the correct service port.: kubectl set env deployment/frontend --args='--backend-url=http://backend.demo.svc.cluster.local:9898/echo'

Method pipeline, model gemini-3.1-flash-lite, 22 read-only calls, 2.2 s.
